claim: Legacy MyMonero: four 32-bit chunks encode a 16-byte seed as 12 words plus prefix CRC32 checksum. Keccak expansion before scalar reduction differs from 32-byte Monero legacy. Current core new_wallet creates a 32-byte/25-word seed; 13 words are retained for legacy decoding. English vector only; other language/product mappings are not verified.
